scope: Source audit and isolated regression tests. Offline tests are not live checkout certification.

shared_fixes.card_receipt: Store the authenticated provider order ID before WooCommerce payment completion hooks. Preserve transaction, amount, currency, merchant and session verification.
shared_fixes.mobile_orders: Filter _mobishop_order_source=mobile in HPOS or legacy order storage. Retain store-api creation semantics and combine existing filters with AND.
shared_fixes.logo: Give web fallback images their uncropped dimensions so saved wordmark geometry is not fitted twice.

checks: merchant checkout fields and shipping contracts

limits: Other gateways need a verified shared adapter; they are not automatically native.
Merchant customizations outside supported checkout contracts need compatibility testing.
A new merchant still requires its actual connector, authentication and signing configuration.

shopify.checkout: Current cart flow launches the validated Shopify checkout URL.
shopify.remaining: Implement and verify the platform-supported in-app checkout and customer account integration against an authorized test store.

odoo.remaining: Connect the native cart, shipping and payment flow to the dedicated customer API; verify against an authorized Odoo store.

regression_gates.github: commerce-contracts job compiles all three platform variants with two separate merchant fixtures each.
regression_gates.codemagic: Every native workflow runs the matrix for its selected platform before building.
regression_gates.failure_policy: Reject missing platform sentinel, skipped tests, failed tests, incomplete execution or nonzero exit status.
